notes: All six planned kinds are new (no old data). Navajo silverwork tradition already in register from shelf 03_00 (Navajo silversmithing), so not repeated. Left out: koru (retrieved Wikipedia page gives no jewellery use), pekapeka (ear pendant, belongs with earrings), Tuareg regional crosses (Iférouane, In Gall, Zinder, Tahoua: only seen in search snippets, not a retrieved page), Gondar and other Ethiopian styles and the matab neck cord (not on retrieved pages). No brands: all forms are maker-free traditions. Parallel fetch was out of credit, Wikidata rate-limited (429); Met Museum fetch 429 and NM Secretary of State page 404, so not used.
